hypothesis: The web-ingress boundary is locally non-authoritative, but a downstream composition can still launder WebActionCandidate provenance into an Agency GoalCandidate by relabeling it SELF_GENERATED because the current Agency V1 registration interface carries no source_ref, WebEvidence identity, policy-adoption receipt, effect class, budget identity or policy version.
strongest_counterhypothesis: No production adapter will ever perform that relabeling, and autonomous execution plus downstream effect-authority gates are sufficient even if goal provenance is dropped.

go_out_of_box_experiment.name: PROVENANCE_LABEL_WASH
go_out_of_box_experiment.method: Instantiate the exact PR330 WebActionCandidate authority semantics, then model the minimal downstream adapter permitted by PR322 register_goal: hash the proposed action, relabel source_kind=SELF_GENERATED, use valid high-but-bounded ranking fields, and evaluate the exact PR322 opportunity-score formula at InitiativePulse=0.12. No target DB, network, provider or external effect is touched.
go_out_of_box_experiment.non_claim: This does not prove a current production adapter performs the relabeling; it proves the two candidate interfaces do not themselves forbid it. FrankExecutionGate remains execution admission and does not mint effect authority.

fusion.interpretation: Local non-authority is insufficient if provenance can be erased before autonomous-goal adoption. The trust label must be monotonic across WebEvidence -> proposal -> goal adoption -> execution/effect proposal.

architecture_delta.proposed_mechanism: Add a typed GoalProposal/GoalAdoptionReceipt boundary. Every agency goal must carry immutable origin/provenance identity, adoption policy version, deterministic effect class, budget identity and an admission receipt. Web-derived goals remain explicitly WEB_DERIVED_UNTRUSTED_EVIDENCE or equivalent and may only become adopted autonomous goals after independent policy verification; they must never be silently rewritten to SELF_GENERATED.
architecture_delta.allowed_web_utility: Do not blanket-deny web-derived goals. Permit them after provenance-preserving independent adoption, especially READ_ONLY or SANDBOX_REVERSIBLE opportunities allowed by the owner-fixed agency contract.
architecture_delta.rollback: Do not merge/promote the proposed adoption mechanism if matched composition tests show no security benefit or unacceptable utility loss.

ordinary_successor_discriminator.name: WEB_TO_AGENCY_PROVENANCE_CONTINUITY_MATRIX
arms: A internal SELF_GENERATED proposal with valid adoption receipt -> may persist/select, subject to normal execution/effect gates
B same semantic action from WebActionCandidate without adoption receipt -> reject before durable goal persistence; zero agency goal/event mutation

C web-derived proposal with exact WebEvidence provenance + independent adoption receipt + READ_ONLY or SANDBOX_REVERSIBLE effect class + valid budget/policy version -> may persist while retaining web lineage
D stale/wrong provenance hash, policy version, effect class or adoption receipt -> fail closed before persistence/selection
ordinary_successor_discriminator.promotion_rule: No F-V01-10 composition promotion until provenance survives web ingress through goal adoption and downstream effect proposal on the accepted target lane.

negative_results_preserved: A target-green parser boundary does not by itself prove end-to-end authority isolation.
Execution-lease exclusivity is not goal-origin trust and is not effect authority.
Semantic hashing of a proposed action does not preserve source provenance.
next_frontier: Compose PR330 web evidence with PR322 agency policy successor using WEB_TO_AGENCY_PROVENANCE_CONTINUITY_MATRIX.
Keep PR330's accepted target boundary evidence; do not regress its strict transport validation.
Integrate adoption receipt with the existing canonical AUTONOMOUS execution lease rather than creating a second execution authority.
Then re-run end-to-end cognition -> proposal -> adoption -> lease -> effect proposal with provenance and effect authority still distinct.
